capabilities: Record system audio and microphone together with one button
Show a live transcript split into other participants and yourself
Re-transcribe the whole recording with a local whisper model
Place screenshots and slide captures at their point on the transcript timeline
Start playback from a clicked transcript timestamp
extras: Apple Silicon and macOS 26+ only; installing the plugin is not enough, a one-time Terminal script compiles a Swift recorder into ~/.config/course-recorder/. Transcription currently supports Mandarin Chinese only. No network requests, accounts or telemetry; optional Ko-fi donations. Full usage docs are in Traditional Chinese in docs/使用說明.md.
motivation: The author built it as a personal tool for recording online meetings, classes and training sessions from inside Obsidian.
problem: Recording a meeting or class in Obsidian means running a separate recorder and then matching the audio by hand to notes, slides and screenshots.

summary: macOS-only recorder that captures system audio and microphone into a note with a live transcript, local whisper re-transcription and timed slides.
